notes: Monthly Google Cloud Platform hosting costs for Observ.ing, broken down by what the money pays for. Figures are gross (before Free Tier and promotional credits, including tax) and are refreshed from the Cloud Billing export after each month closes.

categories.name: Ingestion

categories.name: Species ID
categories.description: Keeping the species identification model loaded so suggestions come back quickly. Before June 2026 the ingester was billed the same way and is counted here.

categories.name: Database

categories.name: Website & API
categories.description: The observ.ing website and API, plus smaller on-demand services such as the live camera model, Storybook and database migrations.

categories.name: Images & CI
